lines.text: Before they knew God, the Galatians were slaves to those who are not gods, and now they were turning back.
The Galatians observed special days, months, seasons and years, and the writer feared his efforts were in vain.
He first preached the gospel to them because of a famine, and they welcomed him as an angel of God.
The Galatians would have given the writer their land, and those people wanted to isolate them from us.
The writer called the Galatians children, was in the pains of childbirth for them, and wished to change his tone.
